bio: Vivek Ganapathy Ramaswamy (born August 9, 1985) is an American billionare businessman, entrepreneur, and former political candidate. He founded Roivant Sciences, a biotechnological pharmaceutical company, in 2014 and was its chief executive officer until 2021. Ramaswamy was a candidate in the 2024 Republican primaries, but withdrew his bid and endorsed Donald Trump.
